entries.switch.name: Toggle sticker manager

fields.desc: One-line description of what the image shows (<=200 chars)
fields.offset: Byte offset to read from (0 = start)
fields.caption: Meme meaning: what this image replies with and what would trigger sending it (optional, <=300 chars)
fields.visible_text: Verbatim text visible in the image (optional, <=200 chars)
panel.title: Sticker Manager
panel.add.need_desc: Description is required: without a meme meaning it is the line she reads
panel.batch.done: Saved {ok} · duplicates skipped {dup} · oversize skipped {big} · failed {fail}
panel.batch.label: Batch save: pick multiple files, file names become descriptions; edit each later
panel.edit.desc.ph: What the image shows, in one line
panel.edit.caption: Meme meaning (the line she reads when picking; empty = clear it)
panel.edit.caption.ph: e.g. finally shipped after being nagged for ages, smug with a hint of relief
panel.edit.visible: Visible text (helps her search only, never shown in the catalog)
panel.group.label: Sticker set
panel.edit.title: Edit this sticker
panel.empty.hint: Add the first sticker above and she can start throwing it around in chat.
panel.empty.title: The library is empty
panel.error.send_cooldown: She just sent one — wait for the cooldown to end.
panel.error.not_enabled: Master switch is off: she neither sends nor sees the catalog.
panel.error.sticker_disabled: This one is disabled; re-enable it in Edit first.
panel.error.sticker_file_missing: The image file is gone; press Repair to drop this entry.
panel.error.sticker_image_unreadable: Cannot read the image (broken or unknown format).
panel.error.duplicate_image: Already in the library; not adding again.
panel.error.image_too_large: A single image must stay under 8MiB.
panel.error.image_undecodable: Image data is corrupted and cannot be decoded.
panel.error.desc_required: Description is required: it is her only picking cue.
panel.error.caption_too_long: Meme meaning too long (300 char cap)
panel.error.visible_text_too_long: Visible text too long (200 char cap)
panel.error.library_io_error: Library read/write failed; see the log.
panel.error.config_unavailable: Config unavailable; the change was not persisted.
panel.error.recent_repeat: She sent this one recently — blocked by the recent-repeat guard (force resend only on the master's explicit ask)
panel.error.probability_declined: The rhythm gate said no sticker this round — she replied in text
panel.error.sticker_too_large: This sticker is too large to send.
panel.error.awareness_disabled: Awareness injection is off: the master switch or awareness.enabled is disabled
panel.error.awareness_no_target: No character card is currently in a conversation to inject into
panel.error.awareness_empty_library: The library is empty - nothing to remind her of
panel.error.library_empty: The library is still empty - nothing to export
panel.error.pack_unreadable: This zip cannot be read (not a valid archive or corrupted)

panel.remove.message: The image and its record will be removed permanently.
panel.remove.title: Delete sticker
panel.repair.done: Done: {entries} entries dropped, {files} orphan files purged, {hashes} hashes backfilled
panel.repair.hint: If an image vanished or a preview looks broken: drops entries with missing files and deletes unreferenced leftovers.
panel.switch: Master switch (off = she sends no stickers and sees no catalog)
panel.awareness.title: Awareness injection
panel.awareness.note: Low-frequency silent hints telling her the sticker room exists and what she uses most. You never see them; they never start a turn. Cadence lives in [sticker_manager.awareness].
panel.usage.note: The ledger keeps time and sticker id only, never conversation text.
plugin.name: Sticker Manager
plugin.short_description: Collect and send stickers: you manage the library in the panel, she picks one and sends it herself
plugin.description: Give her a sticker collection of her own: you add, describe and tag stickers in the panel, and she picks one to send in chat. png/jpg/gif/webp with animations preserved; every send is logged so you can see what she has been using lately.

entries.import_upload_start.name: Start uploading a sticker pack
